_meta.name: Airship map data (traced from the reference map art)
_meta.unit: world units; the ship is 88 units wide
_meta.axes: x = east (+), z = south (+); y is up and not stored
_meta.rooms: polygon = outer outline, holes = obstacles inside the room; neighbouring rooms share borders (the opening between them is the doorway)
_meta.walls: [ax, az, bx, bz, nx, nz] per segment; (nx, nz) is the unit normal pointing to the solid side
_meta.doors: placeholder lines: ax,az,bx,bz = segment ends, x,z = centre, nx,nz = direction, groups = sabotage door group names, kind = sabotage | stall
_meta.escalators: a -> b is the direction of travel; width and lanes describe the walkway; kind = ladder | lift
_meta.safeZones: rectangles (x0,x1,z0,z1) where a player cannot be killed
_meta.hull: polygons [x,z] for the deck, hull plates and the cockpit window
_meta.view: conversion from the 1372-px preview of the reference art: world_x = (px*S - CX)*SC, world_z = (py*S - CY)*SC
_meta.spawns: 6 respawn candidates in the order kitchen, brig, engine, main hall, archive, cargo
_meta.start: where players gather at round start (left platform of the lift)
_meta.doorReview: All 19 door spans aligned with traced jambs / shared room openings, 2026-10-22
